In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] undertook a relief '''mission''' to the planet [[Godo]], where the native [[Godoan/Legends|Godoans]] had fallen victim to a [[Godoan's disease|disease]]. [[General/Legends|Generals]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] helped the Godoans to cure the disease, but Calrissian had fallen ill himself, and the Godoans refused to allow him to enter the sacred [[House of the Goddess]], which contained a healing machine that would heal him. The mission resulted in a standoff between the Alliance [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] and the Godoans when Solo threatened to assault the Godoan capital, forcing the Godoans to allow treatment of Calrissian.
